content: Certain medications, such as diuretics (commonly referred to as water pills), or medical conditions like excessive sweating, diarrhea, or vomiting, can increase your risk of side effects when using this drug. This medication may cause dizziness or drowsiness. Consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can intensify these effects. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages. Liquid forms of this medication may contain sugar and/or alcohol, so caution is advised if you have diabetes, alcohol dependence, or liver disease. Children may be more sensitive to the side effects of this drug, particularly drowsiness, and are at a higher risk of dehydration. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary. While this drug passes into breast milk, it is unlikely to harm a nursing infant. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone overdoses and experiences severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you are taking this medication on a regular schedule and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
